'''Vadoorian sniffer rats''' were a species of presumably rodentian [[Mammal/Legends|mammals]]. A [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] briefly mentioned them after rescuing [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] and [[Jagged Fel]] from an anonymous group seeking out a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Holocron/Legends|Holocron]] as a comparison.

Sometimes used as an analogy, the sniffer rats were presumably used to search out items.
